name: SWE-2.1
notes: Cognition's software engineering model, trained with reinforcement learning on Kimi K3 and available in Devin Desktop, Cloud, and CLI. The announcement also describes SWE-2.1 Ultrafast and SWE-2.1 Cyber, but does not establish exact upstream model IDs, token prices, native context/output limits, modalities, or reasoning controls. No provider variants or aliases are assumed. The 250k-token evaluation context and 1M-token total across compactions are benchmark settings, not confirmed native limits. SWE-2 and Kimi K3 metadata must not be inherited. Temporary free or discounted product offers are not recorded as permanent token prices.
